import re

SRC = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<count>-|#####|=====|[\d.]+[kMGT]?\*?):\s*(?P<line>\d+):(?P<source>.*)$')
FUNC = re.compile(r'^function\s+(?P<name>\S+)\s+called\s+(?P<called>\d+)\s+returned\s+(?P<returned>\S+)\s+blocks executed\s+(?P<blocks>\S+)\s*$')
BR = re.compile(r'^branch\s+(?P<n>\d+)\s+(?:taken\s+(?P<taken>\S+)(?:\s+\((?P<note>[^)]*)\))?|(?P<never>never executed))\s*$')
CALL = re.compile(r'^call\s+(?P<n>\d+)\s+(?:returned\s+(?P<ret>\S+)|(?P<never>never executed))\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    meta = {}
    meta_l = []
    src = []
    src_l = []
    funcs = []
    func_l = []
    brs = []
    br_l = []
    calls = []
    call_l = []
    cur_func = ''
    cur_line = ''
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        if not raw.strip():
            continue
        m = SRC.match(raw)
        if m:
            if m.group('line') == '0':
                k, _, v = m.group('source').partition(':')
                meta[k.strip()] = v.strip()
                meta_l.append(i)
                continue
            cur_line = m.group('line')
            src.append({'function': cur_func, 'count': m.group('count'), 'line': int(cur_line), 'source': m.group('source')})
            src_l.append(i)
            continue
        m = FUNC.match(raw)
        if m:
            cur_func = m.group('name')
            funcs.append({'function': cur_func, 'called': int(m.group('called')), 'returned': m.group('returned'), 'blocks executed': m.group('blocks')})
            func_l.append(i)
            continue
        m = BR.match(raw)
        if m:
            brs.append({'function': cur_func, 'line': cur_line, 'branch': int(m.group('n')), 'taken': m.group('taken') or '', 'note': m.group('note') or m.group('never') or ''})
            br_l.append(i)
            continue
        m = CALL.match(raw)
        if m:
            calls.append({'function': cur_func, 'line': cur_line, 'call': int(m.group('n')), 'returned': m.group('ret') or '', 'note': m.group('never') or ''})
            call_l.append(i)
            continue
    blocks = []
    if meta:
        blocks.append({'name': 'header', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': meta_l, 'records': [meta]})
    if funcs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'functions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': func_l, 'records': funcs})
    if src:
        blocks.append({'name': 'source_lines', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': src_l, 'records': src})
    if brs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'branches', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': br_l, 'records': brs})
    if calls:
        blocks.append({'name': 'calls', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': call_l, 'records': calls})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
